The '''Thranta Clan''' was one of the many [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|clans]] that prospective young [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiates]] were placed in when they first began to learn the ways of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Once a member of the clan, the students would travel together through the [[Jedi academy|academy]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] until the time they [[Initiate Trials/Legends|graduated]].<ref name="TJP" />

Named after the [[Thranta/Legends|thranta]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], this clan was stationed at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Producing many students over the centuries, the clan was dissolved along with the rest of the Order in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="TJP" />

[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] was leader of Thranta Clan. [[Thame Cerulian]] noted that he was the most strict clan instructor and that he didn't nominate a single member of the Clan for the [[InterClan Tournament]].<ref name="TJP" />
